purpose: Strict ratchet for the automatic public-fixture regression gate. It records what was MEASURED on the public upstream test demo; it is not a statement about the real A9.1 demo and it authorizes nothing.

divergenceNotes.none: Under canonical contract v2 no comparable domain diverges on the public fixture. See contractExclusions for the rows rule R13 keeps out of the grenade domain.

grenades.note: Non-grenade entity classes emitted through reused entity ids (upstream entities.rs:388 predicate, stale projectile id set). Measured, not assumed: any other class, or any change in these counts, fails the gate.

syntheticScale.note: Row count and input size of the real A9.1 demo as recorded in run #24/#25 public reports; rows are synthetic.
